status: Coming soon to the App Store
intro: Letters and chat, together in one app. Send words that arrive sealed in wax, framed like art or tucked inside a time capsule, then keep the conversation going in a beautifully simple chat.
waitlist_text: Drop your email and we'll ping you the moment EpistleChat is ready to pre-download on the App Store.
letters_intro: Some things deserve more than a text bubble. Pick how your letter is delivered, and it shows up on the other side like a small event.

styles.name: Museum
styles.text: Your words, framed and exhibited like art.

styles.name: Royal Scroll
styles.text: A royal decree on rolled parchment.

styles.name: Time Capsule
styles.text: Sealed away until the day you choose.

styles.name: Message in a Bottle
styles.text: Corked, tossed to sea, and washed up at their feet.

styles.name: Paper Plane
styles.text: Folded, thrown, and looping straight to them.

chat_intro: A full messenger lives right next to your letters, with messages, communities, voice notes and calls in one calm space.

features.title: Mailbox & Keepsakes
features.text: Letters land in your mailbox. The ones you love get pinned to your Keepsakes wall, polaroid-style.

features.title: Meet Pip
features.text: A friendly capybara who gently nudges you when someone out there is wondering about you.

features.title: Know when it's opened
features.text: Every sent letter shows when it was opened, so you know your words found their way.

features.title: Messages & Communities
features.text: One-on-one chats, group chats and whole communities, all in one tidy inbox.

features.title: Voice notes & calls
features.text: Send a voice message, or jump on a voice or video call straight from the conversation.

features.title: Make it yours
features.text: Custom chat wallpapers, a now-playing song on your profile and name styles that stand out.

more_text: …and plenty more we're saving for launch day.
